title: Database time and size limits answer actionable codes
why: A batch or write that hits a limit answered 500 `BACKEND_INTERNAL`. It now answers 503 or 413 and says nothing was written, and upserting an existing row uses the unique index.
steps: Where client or server code tests for `BACKEND_INTERNAL` or a 500 on batch and writes, handle 503 `BATCH_TOO_SLOW` or `DATABASE_BUSY` (retry) and 413 `VALUE_TOO_LARGE` (send less).
